##### Source: Player's Handbook (Water Breathing)

*3rd-level manipulation (script)*

**Casting Time:** 1 action

**Range:** 30 feet

**Components:** V, S, M (a straw or a snorkel mask)

**Duration:** 24 hours

This tech grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the tech ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

***Tech Lists.*** [Auditor](/techs:auditor), [Mechanist](/techs:mechanist), [Shut-In](/techs:shutin), [Source Coder](/techs:sourcecoder), [Techwizard](/techs:techwizard)
